title: On Lorentzian symmetries of quantum information
summary: A foundational result in relativistic quantum information theory due to Peres, Scudo, and Terno, is that von Neumann entropy is not Lorentz invariant. Motivated by the "It from Qubit" paradigm, here we show that Lorentzian symmetries of quantum information emerge naturally in a pre-spacetime setting, without any reference to external variables such as position or momentum. In particular, we derive the natural action of the restricted Lorentz group $\text{SO}^+(1,3)$ on the internal degrees of freedom of a single qubit from a simple, information-theoretic principle we refer to as preservation…
